premises: Phase-selective recrystallization of the ductile phase in a lamellar eutectic HEA can be achieved by controlled annealing.
Such recrystallization relieves dislocation pile-ups at interphase boundaries, reducing stress concentrations and microcrack initiation.
Relieving pile-ups while preserving the hard phase morphology overcomes brittleness and limited ductility without sacrificing strength.
The concept is applicable to dual-phase lamellar HEAs with soft (FCC) and hard (B2/L12) phases.
